description: This file defines the EmailQueueService class responsible for managing email queue operations within the OrangeHRM system. It handles adding emails to the queue, sending individual emails with locking and error handling, resetting email services, and processing all pending emails. The class interacts with data access objects, email services, and uses traits for logging and date-time utilities.

classes.name: EmailQueueService
classes.description: Service class for managing email queue operations such as adding emails, sending emails with locking, status updates, and processing pending emails within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getEmailQueueDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmailQueueDao instance used to interact with email queue data.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmailService instance used to compose and send individual emails.

methods.name: addToQueue
methods.description: Creates a new Mail object with specified details and saves it to the email queue.

methods.name: sendSingleMail
methods.description: Processes and sends a single email identified by its ID, with locking and status management, including error handling.

methods.name: resetEmailService
methods.description: Resets the email message properties in the EmailService to empty values.

methods.name: changeMailStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a Mail object, setting the sent timestamp if applicable, and saves the change.

methods.name: sendAllPendingMails
methods.description: Retrieves all pending email IDs and processes each email for sending.
